description: Interpolated-recordings sensitivity analysis (06 v1.1 issue 12, §5); run plan D approved by Josue 2026-10-17. Pre-specified; descriptive (06 §4.4); never assigns or revises the RESULT-001 label.

factors_changed.recordings_added: the 7 QC-ineligible recordings with <= 2 non-adjacent bad channels (manifest analysis_set sensitivity_only: DA00100F, DA00100H, DA001036, DA001037, DA00103H, DA00103K, DA00103U; 5 E, 2 F), added to the 69 primary recordings
factors_changed.folds_for_added: their outer folds as already frozen in the F-3 manifest (sensitivity_only rows, seeded by F-3 at 5cc0058); no new assignment is drawn and the 69 keep their folds
factors_changed.interpolation: spherical spline of each added recording's QC-bad channels on the stored rows before every representation (src/preprocessing/interpolate.py: stiffness 4, 50 Legendre terms, lambda 1e-5, positions = 2-D 10-20 read as azimuthal equidistant projection on the unit sphere)
factors_changed.primary_recordings: identical to EXP-004 (no bad channels, nothing interpolated); their cache files are the EXP-004 files

unchanged_from_exp004.epochs_and_exclusions: 06 §4.2 locked exclusions (same kept epochs as EXP-004); the cache check must reproduce the F-6 recount
unchanged_from_exp004.evaluability: >= 5 IED and >= 5 non-IED epochs in a common state, from the F-6 recount (artifacts/dataset_audit/evaluable_recount.csv, which covers the sensitivity_only recordings)
unchanged_from_exp004.fc: wPLI theta/alpha/beta on CAR, §4.3; IAAFT k = 5 per band (D1)
unchanged_from_exp004.learner: HistGradientBoostingClassifier, locked grid (16 points), max_iter 300, no early stopping; random_state = repeat seed + outer fold
unchanged_from_exp004.tuning: nested inner CV, mean within-patient same-state AUROC; ties -> simpler
unchanged_from_exp004.estimand: procedure-level within-patient same-state DeltaAUROC, equal patient weight, per-repeat Delta averaged over repeats
unchanged_from_exp004.window: label-blind salience-selected 2-s window on CAR (06 issue 1), as EXP-004

learner_note: primary learner only; the LR learner is its own robustness factor (06 §5) and is not crossed
restrict_note: also reported: the same contrast over the original 35 evaluable primary patients only, separating the effect of the added training recordings from the added test patients (descriptive)

inference.interval: M1 (06 v1.1 §4.4; RDR-014), 90% and 95%; patient-cluster percentile bootstrap 90%/95% alongside
inference.heterogeneity: R6: SD of Delta_p, 95% prediction interval, range, counts beyond +/- SESOI
inference.state_strata: estimate + 95% percentile bootstrap CI, no outcome label (R10)
inference.pc1: FC-only with the added recordings, M1 95% lower bound of mean AUROC; reported, not a gate here

reading.rule: the seven-rule taxonomy (src/evaluation/taxonomy.classify) applied to the M1 intervals is reported as a descriptive reading of this sensitivity analysis only, never as a label for H-1

concordance.inconclusive: inconclusive (too imprecise to agree or disagree)
